name: smart-token-guard
description: Stop paying for broken AI video renders: QA checks and PASS/RETRY/SWITCH/HALT decisions for AI video.
long_description: Checks keyframes and clips from ComfyUI, Kling, Runway, Veo, Hailuo, Seedance and other AI video tools for blur, exposure, black or frozen frames, flicker, cuts, impacts and look drift. Returns review frames for your assistant to check hands, faces and identity, then decides PASS / RETRY_SAME_MODEL / SWITCH_TO_FALLBACK / HALT with concrete fixes and a local spend ledger. Analysis runs on the SmartTokenGuard API; requires a Starter (US$9/mo, 300 checks) or Pro (US$29/mo, 3,000 checks) subscription.
